components.name: Route File Action
components.description: Primary browse or select action inside the route-file workflow.
components.css: .ds-upload-action { border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-primary-container, #e7e7e4); color: var(--color-on-primary-container, #1c1c1b); padding: 0.75rem 2rem; font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: transform 200ms ease, opacity 200ms ease; } .ds-upload-action:hover { transform: scale(1.05); opacity: 0.9; } .ds-upload-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1b1b1a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-upload-action:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A safe adjacent action for review, continuation, or export.
components.css: .ds-secondary-action { border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface-container-highest, #dbdbd8); color: var(--color-on-surface, #171716); padding: 0.875rem 2rem; font: 700 0.875rem/1.2 var(--font-headline, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-secondary-action:hover { transform: scale(1.02); background: var(--color-surface-container-high, #e4e4e1); } .ds-secondary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1b1b1a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary-action:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Workflow Step
components.description: Numbered progress navigation for upload, review, and export.
components.css: .ds-stepper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-secondary, #686863); font-family: var(--font-headline, sans-serif); } .ds-stepper i { width: 2.25rem; height: 1px; background: var(--color-surface-container-highest, #dbdbd8); } .ds-step { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.25rem; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 700 0.7rem/1.2 var(--font-headline, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-step span { display: grid; width: 1.8rem; height: 1.8rem; place-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface-container-highest, #dbdbd8); transition: transform 200ms ease; } .ds-step:hover span { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-step-active { color: var(--color-on-surface, #171716); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.3rem; } .ds-step-active span { background: var(--color-primary-container, #e7e7e4); color: var(--color-on-primary-container, #1c1c1b); } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #1b1b1a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Strava Connection Action

components.css: .ds-strava-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 1rem; background: #fc4c02; color: #ffffff; padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 0.75rem 1.75rem rgb(252 76 2 / 0.28); font: 900 0.875rem/1.2 var(--font-headline, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-strava-action:hover { background: #e34402; box-shadow: 0 1rem 2.25rem rgb(252 76 2 / 0.36); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-strava-action:hover span { transform: translateX(0.2rem); } .ds-strava-action span { transition: transform 200ms ease; } .ds-strava-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fc4c02; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-strava-action:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Strava Preference Choice
components.description: Pressable choice card for an optional connected-service preference.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: flex; width: 100%; max-width: 28rem; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.85rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-outline-variant, #d0d0cb) 72%, transparent); border-radius: 1.25rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-surface-container-lowest, #ffffff) 76%, transparent); color: var(--color-on-surface, #171716); padding: 1.25rem; text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-body, Inter, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-choice:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-choice-selected { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #1b1b1a) 78%, transparent); background: linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-container, #e7e7e4) 92%, var(--color-surface-container-lowest, #ffffff)), color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-container, #e7e7e4) 65%, var(--color-surface-container-lowest, #ffffff))); box-shadow: 0 1rem 2.5rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #1b1b1a) 15%, transparent); } .ds-choice-icon { display: grid; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--color-town-sign, #f0cf20); color: #171716; font: 900 1.1rem/1 var(--font-headline, sans-serif); } .ds-choice strong, .ds-choice small { display: block; } .ds-choice strong { font: 900 1rem/1.2 var(--font-headline, sans-serif); } .ds-choice small { margin-top: 0.35rem; color: var(--color-secondary, #686863); line-height: 1.45; } .ds-choice b { margin-left: auto; color: var(--color-town-sign, #f0cf20); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-town-sign, #f0cf20); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Ortsschildsprint is a calm, precise companion for working with cycling-route information. It should feel like a capable tool carried on a ride: direct enough for a route workflow, quiet enough for maps and dense ride data, and friendly enough to make review decisions feel safe rather than technical.

The interface uses deliberately strong type and softened panels to make a practical workflow feel approachable. The neutral palette keeps attention on route content; city-sign yellow provides the memorable identity cue and appears only where it carries sign, progress, or selection meaning. The optional Strava flow keeps its own orange connection action so its external-service relationship remains legible.
keyCharacteristics: Calm operational surfaces built from a close grayscale tonal stack.
Bold, compact Space Grotesk headings paired with highly readable Inter body copy.
Soft instrument-panel geometry: rounded, layered, and tactile without becoming decorative.
A rare town-sign yellow identity signal; Strava orange is isolated to Strava connection actions.
Responsive task layouts that make route review, maps, and export decisions feel organized on both mobile and desktop.

rules.name: The Yellow Marker Rule
rules.body: Town-sign yellow is scarce and meaningful. Use it for Ortsschildsprint identity, a city-sign-specific state, or progress that represents sign collection; never turn it into the default button color.

rules.name: The Strava Boundary Rule
rules.body: Strava orange identifies the external connection action only. The rest of the product remains in the Ortsschildsprint neutral-and-yellow system.

rules.name: The Directional Type Rule
rules.body: Use the display and label roles to orient a cyclist through a task. Reserve oversized, black display type for the few moments that establish place, route, or outcome.

rules.name: The Quiet Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows separate tools from the route canvas; they must not make every card look raised or turn the app into a glossy dashboard.

rules.name: The Soft Instrument Rule
rules.body: Controls should feel ready for a gloved thumb or a quick roadside decision: generously rounded, clearly bounded, and never fussy.

dos: Do keep the grayscale surface stack responsible for most hierarchy and depth.
Do use town-sign yellow as the scarce Ortsschildsprint identity and city-sign signal.
Do pair strong Space Grotesk operational labels with calm Inter explanations.
Do use rounded, generously padded controls for route selection, review, export, and connected-service preferences.
Do use ambient shadows only when a panel needs to separate from a map, route canvas, or temporary overlay.
Do keep Strava orange constrained to the Strava authorization action.
donts: Don't make yellow the default action color or spread it across unrelated cards and controls.
Don't introduce a second general-purpose accent color that competes with the town-sign identity.
Don't replace the tonal hierarchy with heavy borders, harsh shadows, or glossy elevation everywhere.
Don't use sharp-cornered controls for core cyclist workflows when the existing soft instrument language fits.
Don't make maps, dense route data, or connected-service panels visually louder than the decision a cyclist needs to make.
